segments.he: אֶחָד יְבָמָה אַחַת, אֶחָד שְׁתֵּי יְבָמוֹת. מַתְנִיתִין דְּלָא כְּבֶן עַזַּאי, דְּתַנְיָא, בֶּן עַזַּאי אוֹמֵר: יֵשׁ מַאֲמָר אַחַר מַאֲמָר בִּשְׁנֵי יְבָמִין וִיבָמָה אַחַת, וְאֵין מַאֲמָר אַחַר מַאֲמָר בִּשְׁתֵּי יְבָמוֹת וְיָבָם אֶחָד.
segments.en: The mishna teaches that all the halakhot with regard to levirate betrothal after levirate betrothal and the like apply «both» in cases of «one yevama» to one yavam, «as well as» in cases of «two yevamot» to one yavam. The Gemara comments: «The mishna is not in accordance with» the opinion of «ben Azzai. As it is taught» in a baraita: «Ben Azzai says: Levirate betrothal is» effective «after levirate betrothal in» the case of «two yevamin and one yevama, but levirate betrothal is not» effective «after levirate betrothal in» the case of «two yevamot and one yavam.» The tanna of the mishna, in contrast, does not differentiate between the cases.
